description: scripts/intake_ledger.py's own append-only history of every data file this project holds (path, size, mtime, md5, row_count, first/last parsed timestamp, present/missing status) -- 'the single place file-count/coverage numbers come from' per that script's docstring. Line-delimited JSON, not CSV -- out of scope for scripts/data_quality.py's column-based checks. data/INTAKE.jsonl (this checkout's own ledger history) is explicitly excluded from being treated as data by intake_ledger.py's own SELF_FILES set; paper_logs/INTAKE.jsonl is NOT in that exclusion set (it lives under a different scanned root) and is the owner-PC's ledger history, carried into this checkout as a reference for what the owner's fuller data tree contains.
source: scripts/intake_ledger.py, run on the owner's PC over its data/paper_logs/backtest_data trees; one JSON line appended per (path, run) whenever that path is new, its content changed (size/mtime/md5), or its present/missing status flipped.
retention: append-only history (never rewritten in place) -- data/INTAKE_latest.json (or paper_logs/INTAKE_latest.json for the owner-PC copy) is the corresponding always-current materialized index keyed by path.
known_defects: jsonl, not CSV -- out of scope for data_quality.py's row-level checks (counted in files_checked, never flagged)

each line has: path, bytes, mtime, md5, row_count, first_ts/last_ts (best-effort parsed timestamp span, capped to the first/last 2000 rows unless --full was used), first_seen/last_seen/checked_at (ledger run timestamps), status (present/missing -- a disappeared file's last known record is KEPT with status='missing', never dropped, per the script's own design note)

this is the OWNER PC's ledger snapshot, not this checkout's own -- paper_logs/INTAKE_latest.json (the materialized index counterpart, a plain .json file and therefore itself out of scope for data_quality.py entirely, not just jsonl-exempt) is the more useful file for seeing what the owner's full data tree contains beyond what this checkout has; do not conflate its counts with this checkout's own data/INTAKE_latest.json
